products.name: Safety 1st Clear View Stove Knob Covers (5 Pack)
products.query: Safety 1st Clear View Stove Knob Covers 5 pack
products.matchName: Safety 1st Clear View Stove Knob Covers
products.summary: A set of five clear, heat-resistant plastic covers with a hinged lid that adults can open to turn the knob. Safety 1st describes them as oversized to fit the knobs of most modern appliances and as a non-adhesive attachment. Consumer Reports names Safety 1st stove knob covers among the products it tested, and BestReviews picks a Safety 1st five-pack as its budget pick.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter with a child or pet and removable knobs who wants nothing stuck to the stove. Caveat: one reviewer-cited issue is that the open lid can touch the oven door, the package says to remove them before using the broiler, and Safety 1st warns of minor surface marks on delicate finishes.
pros: Non-adhesive attachment that is simple to remove, per Safety 1st and BestReviews
Clear plastic lets you see the knob setting, per the retailer listing text
cons: Open lid can interfere with the oven door, per a reviewer on a retailer listing
Must be removed for broiler use per the package; Consumer Reports found covers in general only deter children
products.scoreNote: Non-adhesive and removable, about two dollars per cover on a Walmart listing seen; fit depends on removable knobs.

products.name: Vadiff Silicone Gas Stove Knob Locks (5 Pack)
products.query: Vadiff silicone stove knob covers 5 pack
products.summary: Food-grade silicone covers that slide over the knobs, listed at 430F heat resistance and dishwasher safe. Consumer Reports' photo lists Vadiff among the tested products, and a roundup names it the premium pick. Vadiff says the set covers S-M-L knobs for push-turn, flat-panel configurations.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter with push-to-turn gas knobs on a flat panel who wants a washable, nothing-glued option. Caveat: a Suburban RV owner with pull-off knobs had to wrap the shafts in foil so the locks would not push the knobs off, so check how your knobs are held.
pros: Silicone listed at 430F and dishwasher safe
Slide-on, no adhesive mentioned in the listing text seen
cons: Fit depends on knob type; may force loose pull-off knobs off, per one owner thread
Consumer Reports ranking for it was not visible behind its paywall
products.scoreNote: Washable and removable, but fit is knob-specific and independent verdict not confirmed.
